changesApplied.changeMade: Removed execution_id and variant_id fields. Updated to match Python code: activity_id, template_id, started_at/completed_at, duration_ms, success, tokens_{input,output,cache,total}, cost_usd, error_{message,type}, failed_task_id, impulses*, component_changes. Added indexes for query performance.
changesApplied.reason: Schema mismatch preventing inserts. Python insert_execution() uses different field names than original schema. Alignment enables successful SurrealDB writes.
changesApplied.impactAnalysis: LOW RISK: Schema-only. New table, no migration. Queries succeed after deployment.

changesApplied.changeMade: Added metabobRpcApiUrl: 'http://metabob-rpc-api:8080' environment variable with comprehensive documentation.
changesApplied.reason: OpenCode CLI needs RPC API endpoint URL for POST. Without this, HTTP call fails. Completes infrastructure configuration for data flow.
changesApplied.impactAnalysis: ZERO RISK: Additive. Backward compatible. OpenCode checks env var before use.

changesApplied.changeMade: Enhanced to be DUAL PURPOSE: (1) Persist to SurrealDB via insert_execution(), (2) Update Thompson Sampling metrics. Added validation, timestamp parsing, error handling, documentation. Accepts activity_id, template_id, timestamps, tokens, cost, success, optional errors.
changesApplied.reason: Original only updated Redis metrics, not SurrealDB. Needed complete flow: OpenCode → RPC API → SurrealDB → Dashboard.
changesApplied.impactAnalysis: LOW RISK: Maintains backward compat. Async, non-blocking. Validates inputs. Logs failures without crash.

changesApplied.changeMade: Added HTTP POST to RPC API /v2/activities/executions after completion. Sends execution data (activity_id, template_id, timestamps, duration, success, tokens, cost, impulses). Non-blocking try-catch. Checks METABOB_RPC_API_URL env var. Graceful degradation.
changesApplied.reason: CRITICAL MISSING LINK. Without this, activities in devbob invisible to dashboard. Completes end-to-end: OpenCode CLI → SurrealDB → Dashboard UI.
changesApplied.impactAnalysis: MINIMAL RISK: Non-blocking. Failure doesn't break activity. Wrapped in try-catch with warnings. Only if env var configured.
